raw.buffDescription: The Defender has Protection, reducing all incoming damage by 60%. Hitting the Defender with a Heavy Attack removes the Protection and grants the Attacker a Cruelty Passive, increasing Critical Damage Rating by 30% for 12 second(s). When the Cruelty expires, the Protection returns, and all Debuffs on the Defender are Purified.
